symbols.name: defun
symbols.summary: Creates a named AutoLISP function.
symbols.detail: Names following the slash in the parameter list are local bindings. A name beginning with c: defines an AutoCAD command entry point.

symbols.name: setq
symbols.summary: Stores values in one or more symbols.
symbols.detail: Declare temporary symbols as function locals so assignments do not leak into the drawing session.

symbols.name: if
symbols.summary: Chooses between a true branch and an optional false branch.
symbols.detail: Each branch occupies one expression position; use progn when a branch needs a sequence.

symbols.name: cond
symbols.summary: Evaluates the expressions belonging to the first true clause.
symbols.detail: Use a final T clause when the decision requires a default.

symbols.name: progn
symbols.summary: Treats several expressions as one expression and returns the last result.
symbols.detail: It is commonly used where if supplies only one expression slot per branch.

symbols.name: while
symbols.summary: Repeats a body while its test is non-nil.
symbols.detail: Make the body advance every value used by the test so termination remains reviewable.

symbols.name: repeat
symbols.summary: Runs a body a fixed number of times.
symbols.detail: Use repeat when no item binding or condition is needed.

symbols.name: foreach
symbols.summary: Evaluates a body once for each list member.
symbols.detail: The named symbol is rebound to each member in order.

symbols.name: mapcar
symbols.summary: Builds a list from applying a function across one or more lists.
symbols.detail: Use it when the returned list is part of the result rather than incidental loop state.

symbols.name: command
symbols.summary: Feeds command names, options, and values to AutoCAD's command processor.
symbols.detail: Command availability and prompting are host-dependent. Prefix standard command and option strings for language portability.

symbols.name: princ
symbols.summary: Prints an expression without adding a newline.
symbols.detail: A final no-argument call keeps a command from echoing an incidental return value.

symbols.name: getint
symbols.summary: Requests an integer from the user.
symbols.detail: Its accepted input is limited to a signed 16-bit range; choose another input path when larger values are valid.

symbols.name: getreal
symbols.summary: Requests a real number from the user.
symbols.detail: Interactive input functions require a host that can prompt.

symbols.name: getstring
symbols.summary: Requests string input from the user.
symbols.detail: Set the optional flag when spaces must be accepted, and do not use this prompt in an unattended worker.

symbols.name: strcat
symbols.summary: Returns the concatenation of its string arguments.
symbols.detail: Convert non-string values explicitly before concatenating them.

symbols.name: car
symbols.summary: Returns the first member of a nonempty list.
symbols.detail: Check for nil before taking the car of an optional lookup result.

symbols.name: cdr
symbols.summary: Returns everything after a list's first member.
symbols.detail: For a dotted pair returned by assoc, cdr yields the stored value.

symbols.name: cons
symbols.summary: Constructs a pair whose first part and remainder are supplied separately.
symbols.detail: With a list as the second argument, it prepends one member.

symbols.name: list
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the evaluated arguments.
symbols.detail: It is useful for fixed-shape argument and entity-data construction.

symbols.name: equal
symbols.summary: Compares two expressions and can apply a numeric tolerance.
symbols.detail: Supply a tolerance when equality depends on calculated real values.

symbols.name: entget
symbols.summary: Returns the data list for an entity name.
symbols.detail: Read fields by group-code lookup instead of depending on list position.

symbols.name: entmod
symbols.summary: Submits an updated entity-data list to the current drawing.
symbols.detail: Change only fields whose mutation contract is known, then check the return value and persisted state.

symbols.name: entmake
symbols.summary: Creates a drawing record from supplied entity data.
symbols.detail: The required group codes depend on the record type; reject an incomplete specification before mutation.

symbols.name: ssget
symbols.summary: Builds a selection set from an interaction mode, geometry, or filter.
symbols.detail: Prompting modes require an interactive host; database-wide filtered selection can be suitable for a worker.

symbols.name: ssname
symbols.summary: Returns the entity name stored at a selection-set index.
symbols.detail: Use a zero-based index and keep it below sslength.

symbols.name: sslength
symbols.summary: Returns the number of entities in a selection set.
symbols.detail: Capture the count before an index loop and release the set when the worker finishes.

symbols.name: vlax-get-acad-object
symbols.summary: Returns the application object for the current full AutoCAD session.
symbols.detail: This ActiveX function is Windows-only and should not be assumed available in a console worker.

symbols.name: vla-get-activedocument
symbols.summary: Reads the active document from an AutoCAD application object.
symbols.detail: Load ActiveX support explicitly and keep this call in the interactive Windows adapter.

symbols.name: vlax-for
symbols.summary: Iterates through members of an ActiveX collection.
symbols.detail: Its availability follows the ActiveX host boundary and the collection's object model.
